question: A charge $-3 \times 10^{-6}\text{ C}$ is moved slowly from a point at potential $-40\text{ V}$ to another point at potential $160\text{ V}$. Calculate the change in potential energy of the charge and state whether the external agent does positive or negative work. Justify your answer.

options.A: $\Delta U=+6.0\times10^{-4}\,\text{J}$ and the external agent does positive work
options.B: $\Delta U=-6.0\times10^{-4}\,\text{J}$ and the external agent does positive work
options.C: $\Delta U=q(V_B-V_A)=-6.0\times10^{-4}\,\text{J}$; for slow motion, $W_{\text{ext}}=\Delta U$, so the external agent does negative work
options.D: $\Delta U=0$ because the charge is moved slowly
